Name: Remove Senders from Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules
Author: admin
DisplayName: Remove Senders from Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules
Description: Action will get as a parameter a list of Senders, or will work on User entities (if parameters are not provided), and will be able to remove the provided Senders from the existing rules. WARNING: Action will modify your current users inbox rules, using EWS. NOTICE - to perform operation, please configure EDiscovery Group and Author permissions. For full details, please visit: https://cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/soar/marketplace-integrations/exchang. NOTE: Action is running as async, please adjust script timeout value in Siemplify IDE for action as needed.

Parameters.Description: Specify the Senders you would like to remove from the rule, in a comma separated list. If no parameter will be provided, action will work with entities.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Siemplify - Senders List - Move To Junk
Parameters.Description: Specify the rule to remove the Senders from. If the rule doesn't exist - action will do nothing.
OptionalValues: Siemplify - Senders List - Move To Junk

Parameters.DisplayName: Remove Senders from all available Rules
Parameters.Description: Specify whether action should look for the provided Senders in all of Siemplify inbox rules.

Parameters.DisplayName: Should remove senders' domains from the corresponding Domains List rule as well?
Parameters.Description: Specify whether the action should automatically take the domains of the provided email addresses and remove them as well from the corresponding domain rules (same rule action for domains)

If checked, action will be performed in all mailboxes accessible with current impersonalization settings. If delegated access is used, implicitly specify the mailboxes to search in the "Mailboxes" parameter.

Parameters.DisplayName: How many mailboxes to process in a single batch
Parameters.Description: In case "Perform action in all mailboxes" is checked, action works in batches, this parameter controls how many mailboxes action should process in single batch (single connection to mail server).

AIDescription:
Removes specific sender email addresses or domains from existing Exchange inbox rules. This action is designed to manage rules typically created for security automation (e.g., moving malicious senders to junk). It can target a specific rule or all available Siemplify-managed rules across one or multiple mailboxes. The action supports batch processing and runs asynchronously to handle large environments without timing out.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Senders | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses to remove from the rule. If not provided, the action will use the identifiers of User entities in the case. |
| Rule to remove Senders from | String | Yes | The specific inbox rule name to modify. Options include 'Siemplify - Senders List - Move To Junk', 'Siemplify - Senders List - Delete', or 'Siemplify - Senders List - Permanently Delete'. |
| Remove Senders from all available Rules | Boolean | No | If true, the action will attempt to remove the senders from all predefined Siemplify sender rules instead of just the one specified. |
| Should remove senders' domains from the corresponding Domains List rule as well? | Boolean | No | If true, the action extracts domains from the email addresses and removes them from the corresponding domain-based inbox rules. |
| Perform action in all mailboxes | Boolean | No | If true, the action will be performed across all mailboxes accessible via the current impersonation/delegation settings. |
| How many mailboxes to process in a single batch | Integer | No | Controls the number of mailboxes processed in a single execution cycle (default is 50). |

### Additional Notes
- This action requires EDiscovery Group and Author permissions to modify inbox rules via EWS.
- The action is asynchronous; ensure the script timeout in the IDE is adjusted if processing a very large number of mailboxes.

### Flow Description
1. **Initialization**: Initializes the Exchange manager using the integration's configuration (Server Address, Credentials, etc.).
2. **Sender Identification**: Retrieves the list of email addresses to remove from the 'Senders' parameter. If empty, it extracts identifiers from all 'USER' entities associated with the alert.
3. **Rule Selection**: Determines which inbox rules to target based on the 'Rule to remove Senders from' and 'Remove Senders from all available Rules' parameters. If domain removal is enabled, it also identifies the corresponding domain rules.
4. **Mailbox Discovery**: Identifies the target mailboxes. If 'Perform action in all mailboxes' is selected, it fetches all searchable mailboxes from the server.
5. **Batch Processing**: Iterates through the mailboxes in batches. For each mailbox, it retrieves the current rules and removes the specified senders or domains from the rule conditions.
6. **Rule Update**: Updates the rule on the Exchange server. If a rule becomes empty after removal, it is deleted.
7. **State Management**: Saves the progress (processed vs. remaining mailboxes) and continues execution until all mailboxes are updated.
